component.name: MainScene
component.script:
sub init() m.cBg = "0x0D1117FF" m.cHeader = "0x161B22FF" m.cBorder = "0x30363DFF" m.cText = "0xE6EDF3FF" m.cSubtext = "0x8B949EFF" m.isPlaying = false m.currentCh = invalid buildUI() setupVideoPlayer() setupTimer() m.iptv.callFunc("load", {}) m.top.setFocus(true) end sub
sub buildUI() bg = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") bg.width = 1280 bg.height = 720 bg.color = m.cBg buildHeader() sep = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") sep.translation = [0, 68] sep.width = 1280 sep.height = 2 sep.color = m.cBorder m.iptv = m.top.createChild("IPTVPanel") m.iptv.translation = [0, 70] m.iptv.visible = true m.iptv.observeField("selectedChannel", "onChannelSelected") sep2 = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") sep2.translation = [0, 694] sep2.width = 1280 sep2.height = 2 sep2.color = m.cBorder hint = m.top.createChild("Label") hint.translation = [40, 698] hint.text = "^v/OK Browse channels * Reload Back / Home = exit" hint.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" hint.color = m.cSubtext end sub
sub buildHeader() bar = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") bar.translation = [0, 0] bar.width = 1280 bar.height = 68 bar.color = m.cHeader title = m.top.createChild("Label") title.translation = [40, 16] title.text = "MasterChief TV" title.font = "font:MediumBoldSystemFont" title.color = m.cText m.clockLabel = m.top.createChild("Label") m.clockLabel.translation = [1080, 24] m.clockLabel.text = "" m.clockLabel.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" m.clockLabel.color = m.cSubtext m.npHeader = m.top.createChild("Label") m.npHeader.translation = [320, 16] m.npHeader.text = "" m.npHeader.font = "font:MediumBoldSystemFont" m.npHeader.color = "0xFFD700FF" m.npHeader.visible = false updateClock() end sub
sub setupVideoPlayer() m.video = m.top.createChild("Video") m.video.translation = [0, 0] m.video.width = 1280 m.video.height = 720 m.video.visible = false m.video.observeField("state", "onVideoState") m.video.observeField("errorInfo", "onVideoError") m.loadingLbl = m.top.createChild("Label") m.loadingLbl.translation = [400, 332] m.loadingLbl.text = "Connecting..." m.loadingLbl.font = "font:MediumBoldSystemFont" m.loadingLbl.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" m.loadingLbl.visible = false m.backHint = m.top.createChild("Label") m.backHint.translation = [40, 690] m.backHint.text = "Back = stop" m.backHint.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" m.backHint.color = "0xCCCCCCCC" m.backHint.visible = false end sub
sub onChannelSelected() ch = m.iptv.selectedChannel if ch = invalid then return if ch.url = "" then return m.currentCh = ch playChannel(ch) end sub
sub playChannel(ch as Dynamic) m.isPlaying = true content = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") content.url = ch.url url = LCase(ch.url) if Instr(1, url, ".m3u8") > 0 or Instr(1, url, "hls") > 0 content.streamFormat = "hls" else if Instr(1, url, ".mpd") > 0 content.streamFormat = "dash" else if Instr(1, url, ".mp4") > 0 content.streamFormat = "mp4" else content.streamFormat = "hls" end if content.title = ch.name m.video.content = content m.video.visible = true m.iptv.visible = false m.video.control = "play" m.video.setFocus(true) m.npHeader.text = "> " + ch.name m.npHeader.visible = true m.loadingLbl.text = "Connecting..." m.loadingLbl.visible = true m.backHint.visible = true end sub
sub stopPlayback() m.isPlaying = false m.video.control = "stop" m.video.visible = false m.iptv.visible = true m.npHeader.visible = false m.loadingLbl.visible = false m.backHint.visible = false m.top.setFocus(true) end sub
sub onVideoState() state = m.video.state if state = "buffering" m.loadingLbl.text = "Buffering..." m.loadingLbl.visible = true else if state = "playing" m.loadingLbl.visible = false else if state = "stopped" or state = "finished" if m.isPlaying then stopPlayback() end if end sub
sub onVideoError() info = m.video.errorInfo if info <> invalid msg = "" if info.doesExist("errorMsg") then msg = info.errorMsg m.loadingLbl.text = "Error: " + msg m.loadingLbl.visible = true end if end sub
sub setupTimer() m.timer = m.top.createChild("Timer") m.timer.duration = 1 m.timer.repeat = true m.timer.observeField("fire", "onTick") m.timer.control = "start" end sub
sub onTick() updateClock() if not m.isPlaying then m.top.setFocus(true) end sub
sub updateClock() dt = CreateObject("roDateTime") dt.ToLocalTime() h = dt.GetHours() min = dt.GetMinutes() sec = dt.GetSeconds() m.clockLabel.text = RightPad(h) + ":" + RightPad(min) + ":" + RightPad(sec) end sub
function RightPad(n as Integer) as String s = str(n).trim() if len(s) = 1 then s = "0" + s return s end function
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false if m.isPlaying if key = "back" stopPlayback() return true end if return false end if return false end function
